message.content: {"caption":"Workflow for comparing skill-enabled and skill-free executions, diagnosing differences, and revising a skill under verification.","description":"A three-stage process diagram. Setup compiles a task verifier from explicit requirements and establishes matched runs with the same task and workspace, varying whether the skill is loaded. Compare and diagnose shows paired executions with and without the skill; PACE evaluates process adherence, artifact evidence, consistency, and effectiveness delta, then marks passages to edit or preserve, alongside a verifier check. Edit and check maps verdicts to actions: helped prompts editing, inert prompts deferral, and hurt prompts rejection. A Skill Iterator applies either Refine, which preserves the workflow while correcting local defects, or Repair, which replaces conflicting procedures or adds missing execution information. The candidate skill cycles back through evaluation and can become an evolved skill.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
